versions.content: Service Name Bmc_FetchAnd_s Syntax Bmc_AtomicSType Bmc_FetchAnd_s ( volatile Bmc_AtomicSType * Object, Bmc_AtomicSType Operand ) Service ID [hex] 0x94 to 0x97 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) None Object Object Parameters (inout) Operand Value for the operation Parameters (out) None Return value Bmc_AtomicSType The value pointed to by Object immediately before the effects Description Atomically replaces the value pointed to by Object with the result of the and-operation applied to the value pointed to by Object and the given Operand. Available via Bmc.h
